_metadata.description: Header-comment-driven indexer that walks the components root and upserts a SQLite-backed registry of shared UI primitives.

requirements.title: Indexer walks the configured components root and parses @libraryId header comments
requirements.description: On startup and on `react-component-library components index`, the indexer enumerates *.tsx files under the resolver-scoped components root, parses the `@libraryId`/`@displayName`/`@description`/`@version`/`@sourcePath`/`@warning`/`@deps` header comment, and upserts a row into `components` + `component_headers` in SQLite.

validation.notes: TestIndexer_RunWalksAndUpserts proves root walking, JSDoc header parsing, and SQLite upsert through the repository; TestIndexer_RunIndexesEntryAndCompanionFiles covers the multi-file entry+companion unit. Ref updated from the retired TestIndexer_RunIndexesManifestVersionsAndStyles name. Verified passing 2026-07-14 (whole internal/components package green).

requirements.title: Missing or malformed header comments reject with a structured error
requirements.description: If a candidate file omits required header fields or has a malformed `@deps` JSON, the indexer surfaces a structured `IndexerError{Path, Line, Field, Reason}` rather than silently skipping. CLI `components index` exits non-zero when any error is present; default human output prints one line per error.

validation.notes: TestIndexer_RunReportsMalformedHeaderErrors covers missing/malformed required header fields; TestIndexer_RunFindsHeaderVersionDisagreementWithoutRejecting and its status/deps siblings cover structural non-fatal findings. Ref updated from the retired TestIndexer_RunReportsInvalidHeaders name. Verified passing 2026-07-14.

requirements.title: Header-parse regex tolerates leading `/**` and `*` indentation
requirements.description: The parser must accept the canonical JSDoc-style header (block comment, leading `*` per line) and a single-line `//` form for `@libraryId` only; whitespace tolerance must not let undelimited fields bleed into adjacent fields.

validation.notes: The canonical JSDoc block form is exercised through the indexer fixtures in TestIndexer_RunWalksAndUpserts; malformed and disagreement paths are covered by adjacent indexer tests. Ref updated from the retired TestIndexer_RunIndexesManifestVersionsAndStyles name. Verified passing 2026-07-14.

requirements.title: Component manifests index slot and design-style affinity metadata
requirements.description: The manifest indexer parses component.json `slot` and optional `designStyles[]` declarations, validates slot and affinity enums, validates style ids against templates/design metadata, persists slot on `components`, and persists affinity rows plus optional rationale in `component_design_affinities`.

validation.notes: TestIndexer_RunReportsInvalidDesignAffinity, TestIndexer_RunReportsInvalidSlot, and TestIndexer_RunFlagsUnknownDesignStyleWithoutRejecting in indexer_test.go cover affinity/slot validation; sqlite_test.go covers affinity rationale persistence and style/affinity search. Verified passing 2026-07-14 (internal/components package green).

requirements.title: Latest-version headers populate typed facets and non-structural component_headers
requirements.description: Indexing stores latest-version JSDoc header metadata in `component_headers` while excluding structural fields already persisted elsewhere (`libraryId`, `version`, `deps`, and `category`). Category search is backed by the typed `components.category` column.

validation.notes: api/internal/components/sqlite_test.go::TestSQLiteRepository_UpsertManifestPersistsLatestHeadersForCategoryFacet verifies header sync, structural-field exclusion, typed category promotion, and category filtering. api/internal/components/indexer_test.go covers structural header disagreement findings for @version, @status, and malformed @deps while typed projection facts remain authoritative. Verified passing 2026-07-14.

requirements.title: Registry schema leaves room for future external component imports
requirements.description: The registry model can later distinguish locally-authored components from npm/external imported components without breaking existing component ids, version rows, or adoption records.

validation.notes: Future schema tests should cover external-source metadata round-trip and compatibility with existing local component rows.
